title: CatalogPush
description: Authenticated envelope for a Sub-initiated encrypted catalog snapshot left in a pair's mailbox. Same shape as catalog-response, except it names the Owner receive key it was encrypted to (receiveKeyId) instead of a request, and may be retained up to catalogMailboxExpirySeconds. snapshotId shares the pair epoch's monotonic sequence with catalog-response.

expiresAt.description: MUST NOT exceed createdAt + catalogMailboxExpirySeconds (see constants.json).

senderEphemeralPublicKey.description: Sub's per-upload ephemeral ECDH public key, combined with the Owner receive key named by receiveKeyId. HKDF info is "oathbound-relay-catalog-push-v1" || pairIdHash || receiveKeyId; salt and AAD are built exactly as for catalog-response.
